claim: AWS Control Tower has overall concurrency limitations: in general, one operation at a time is permitted, with two exceptions: optional controls can be activated and deactivated concurrently, and Account Factory can provision, update and enroll accounts concurrently.

qualifiers.condition: except optional control operations and Account Factory account operations

evidence.quote: In general, one operation at a time is permitted. Two exceptions to this limitation are allowed:
Optional controls can be activated and deactivated concurrently, through an asynchronous process.
Accounts can be provisioned, updated, and enrolled concurrently in Account Factory, through an asynchronous process, with up to five (5) account-related operations in progress simultaneously.
